method: Compact evidence from 100 earned W1-20 attempts, 36 synthetic max-rank checkpoints and one native W1-6 prefix. Configurations must remain separate; these are diagnostic rules, not human winrates. Original reports retain per-worker logs locally. No weapon, difficulty or economy values changed. The last melee control includes the reflected-damage projectile-cancellation fix.

baseline.method: Rule-based, delayed common-viewport observations; diagnostic, not human winrates. Independent movement and build policies, actual movement/dash and earned progression. Probes ending by W5 retain the historical early boss-kill stop. Longer runs follow complete timed boss waves, loot, offered relics and shops through W20. One free starter; all subsequent gear and ranks are earned. No future spawns or hidden attack planning.
